blockingFindings.title: No strict rewind-boundary coverage for test-result-review artifacts
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement explicitly names test-result-review in the freshness rule, but the tests do not cover its exact boundary behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: R1 requires scenario-validity, test-execute, and test-result-review artifacts to be classified as current only when their mtime is strictly later than the latest rewoundAt. The boundary test covers scenario-validity and test-execute only; test-result-review is only tested as stale before rewind in a passing scenario, not at the exact boundary or as a current/stale classification boundary.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion that a test-result-review artifact at rewoundAt is treated as stale and does not participate in mechanical validation, plus a strictly-after counterpart if needed to prove the boundary.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement explicitly names test-result-review in the freshness rule, but the tests do not cover its exact boundary behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Malformed eligible producer evidence coverage is incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: The requirement covers malformed eligible evidence generally across the producer completion artifacts, but only one producer path is exercised.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires malformed eligible evidence to continue exposing producer-specific mechanical issue codes. The tests only assert this for current malformed scenario-validity evidence; there is no equivalent current malformed test-execute or test-result-review coverage.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add current, post-rewind malformed evidence cases for test-execute and test-result-review that assert their existing producer-specific mechanical issue codes are reported and not replaced by durable-artifact-stale.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement covers malformed eligible evidence generally across the producer completion artifacts, but only one producer path is exercised.
